pinRationale: Pinned to HEAD at the time this matrix was hardened. Gradle 9.7.1 runs natively on a JDK-21 runner (no discovery fallback needed).
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion were confirmed by reading build files at the pinned commit. moduleCount is NOT the number of include(...) lines (2): settings.gradle.kts has include(":analytics:testkitchen") but no include(":analytics") — Gradle still creates :analytics as an implicit parent project, so the real count is 3. jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion/androidNdkVersion were confirmed by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout with no Android SDK present at all, proving they are AGP's own deterministic resolution rather than something read from an installed SDK.

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum" — app/build.gradle sets sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility/jvmTarget = JavaVersion.VERSION_17/JvmTarget.JVM_17 (a bytecode-compatibility setting, not a toolchain declaration); AGP 9.4.1 (gradle/libs.versions.toml: android-application plugin version.ref="gradle"="9.4.1") requires JDK 17+, which is what resolves (consistent with the explicit 17 here, but the AGP floor is what actually drives it — see signal.json for a case where an explicit toolchain overrides this floor)

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in build.gradle files; this is AGP 9.4.1's own default build-tools version (same default observed for Timber's AGP 9.4.0 and Now In Android's AGP 9.3.2 — the AGP 9.x line's default tracks its own release train, not the project's compileSdk of 37)

moduleCount.source: settings.gradle.kts explicitly includes only ":app" and ":analytics:testkitchen", but Gradle auto-creates ":analytics" as an implicit parent project for the multi-segment path — confirmed by verified run (modules array: :analytics, :analytics:testkitchen, :app)

ndkPresent.source: verified run: androidNdkVersion="28.2.13676358" — AGP 9.x auto-resolves a default NDK version even though this project has zero native code (no externalNativeBuild/CMakeLists.txt anywhere); same AGP-version-dependent behavior seen for Timber and Now In Android
